== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Premiere [[BoShek]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/BoShek (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Set 1 article titles follow the approved #384 scheme: Original unnumbered, Numbered (or Numbered black-on-white / Numbered white-on-black), Premium, Remastered (2006). [[BoShek (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]] redirects to the Remastered (2006) article.

Premium article uses the printed Premium title [[Bo Shek (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium)]]. [[BoShek (V)]] is Virtual Block 1. No numbered white-on-black article exists yet.
